name: plan_cdgx_through
label: The plan, CDG Express through to Montparnasse
about: CDG Express as planned for 28 March 2027: a train every 15 minutes, 20 minutes without a stop from the airport (terminal 2) to Gare de l’Est. With the surface of Gare de l’Est closed, it is given the RER G platforms of Nord-Est (ASSUMPTION; the study lists its terminus as an open point). Here it runs on through the RER G tunnel to Châtelet-Les Halles and Montparnasse, in the minutes of RER G.
